m1_fast.name: M1 Mac - Fast (Piper)
m1_fast.description: Optimized for Apple Silicon. Best for long books (1-3 hours generation). Uses CPU-only inference with low memory usage.
m1_fast.notes: Efficient and fast. Good quality. Won't overheat your Mac.

m1_quality.name: M1 Mac - Quality (Kokoro)
m1_quality.description: Natural-sounding TTS with MPS acceleration. Balanced speed and quality for audiobooks.
m1_quality.notes: Uses Metal Performance Shaders for GPU acceleration. Very natural voice quality.

m1_balanced.name: M1 Mac - Balanced (XTTS)
m1_balanced.description: XTTS with CPU/MPS optimization. Higher quality with voice cloning support.
m1_balanced.notes: Slower but supports voice cloning. Consider breaks for long sessions.

high_end_gpu.name: High-End GPU (XTTS + RVC)
high_end_gpu.description: Maximum quality with RVC enhancement and NISQA evaluation. Requires NVIDIA GPU.

low_power.name: Low-Power Mode (Silero)
low_power.description: Pure CPU inference with minimal resource usage. Best for battery saving.
low_power.notes: Runs on any CPU. Lower quality but very efficient.
